meta.title: Sci-Hub / LibGen / Z-Library Fetcher
meta.description: Adds fourteen tools. scihub_pdf / scihub_batch take a DOI or an article/PDF URL (or a list of DOIs), resolve them through Sci-Hub mirrors and download the paper PDFs into `scihub/`. libgen_search searches Library Genesis by keyword and returns hits with MD5, title, author, year, size and format; libgen_download fetches the chosen file by MD5 into `libgen/`, keeping its real extension (pdf/epub/djvu/...). Nine zlib_* tools add native Z-Library EAPI support: zlib_status checks login state and daily quota, zlib_search finds books by keyword, zlib_get_book reads details, zlib_download fetches a book into `zlib/`, zlib_profile shows account/quota, zlib_saved lists saved books, zlib_history lists downloads, zlib_check_domains probes reachable domains and zlib_delete_history removes a history entry. Z-Library credentials are read only from process.env (ZLIB_EMAIL + ZLIB_PASSWORD or ZLIB_COOKIE, plus ZLIB_DOMAIN), never from tool parameters or session text. scihub_refresh_mirrors re-probes all candidate mirrors, drops the dead/captcha ones and writes the live ones back to lib/mirrors.json for self-healing, effective immediately without a restart. All outbound requests support an HTTP/HTTPS CONNECT proxy via config.proxy or the HTTPS_PROXY / HTTP_PROXY / ALL_PROXY environment variables (NO_PROXY honoured), for networks where the mirrors are only reachable through a proxy. All files get consistent, human-readable names built from citation/hit metadata via fileNameTemplate (empty value restores the old DOI-based names) and are never silently overwritten. Mirror lists live in lib/mirrors.json and lib/libgen-mirrors.json and are re-read on every call. Batches run with bounded parallelism (4 workers, results stay in input order), unreachable mirrors are skipped for the rest of the batch, and truncated downloads or browser-verification pages are rejected instead of saved.
